articles.title: Nepal flooding deaths surpass 900 as needs climb
articles.summary: The confirmed death toll from Nepal’s catastrophic floods has surged to 903, with more than 4,200 still missing as rescue crews and humanitarian workers battle blocked highways to reach the hardest-hit areas, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said on Monday. articles.title: Morocco not to blame for Ceuta border breach, says Spanish PM

As many as 141 people are thought to have died trying to enter the Spanish enclave at the end of July.

articles.title: Hollow Promises: Resetting Gaza’s Ceasefire
articles.summary: A July roadmap sponsored by the Board of Peace has failed to overcome obstacles that have mired Gaza’s ceasefire deal ten months on. articles.title: Curbing Reprisals in Syria
articles.summary: Fuelled by wartime grievances, mob attacks and other forms of retribution threaten Syria’s transition. Damascus has done too little to deter such acts. It should ensure visible legal consequences for violence and broaden locally rooted policing to rebuild trust among vulnerable communities. Curbing Reprisals in Syria.

articles.summary: India announced a new industrial policy aimed at boosting domestic manufacturing to meet the standards required for inclusion in the Fortune 500 list. The policy targets a 20 percent increase in export‑oriented production by 2030 and sets up a fund of 50 billion rupees for technology upgrades. Officials said the plan will create 1.5 million jobs and raise the country’s global market share to 4 percent. Analysts warn that without sustained investment, India will struggle to compete with established Fortune 500 firms.

articles.summary: New York Stabbing at Times Square: अमेरिका के न्यूयॉर्क में टाइम्स स्क्वेयर पर चाकूबाजी की घटना सामने आई है. यहां पर एक महिला ने हाथ में कई चाकू लेकर अचानक लोगों पर हमला करना शुरू कर दिया. उसके हमले में एक की मौत हो गई, जबकि दूसरा जख्मी हो गया. हालांकि पुलिस ने महिला को काबू करने के लिए गोली चलाई, जिसमें उसकी मौत हो गई.
